standard_prerequisites.use: Convert the required vanishing of the comparison map into a factorisation statement, which is then verified diagrammatically.

core_obligations: Choose a good representative: for the case of positive dimension parameter the proof represents the given complex by a two-term complex whose first term is projective for the ideal power, in particular multiplication by elements of the ideal power factors through the second term (proof lines 5469-5476)

Reduce to a factorisation: using the description of maps out of an almost free module, the proof reduces the vanishing of the comparison map to exhibiting a factorisation of the composite map through the appropriate shifted ideal quotient (proof lines 5476-5520)

Verify the diagram: the proof constructs a map from the pullback of the second term to the structure sheaf of the closed subscheme fitting into the relevant diagram, and chases the diagram to obtain the required factorisation (proof lines 5520-5545)
Conclusion: the comparison map is zero, which is the statement (proof line 5545)
proof_roadmap: 取 K 的两项表示 K^{-1} → K^0，其中 K^{-1} 对 I^c/I^n 是投射的（乘法通过 K^0 分解）。
用「由几乎自由模出发的映射」的描述把比较映射的消没化归为一个通过移位理想商的分解，再构造 p^*K^0 → O_{Y_n}(n-c) 的映射并追图，得到该分解。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement asserts the vanishing of the comparison map on first Ext of a two-term complex after shifting by a controlled amount (author lemma at source lines 5450-5467, label lemma-bound-two-term-complex), under an explicit numerical hypothesis on the exponent and under the hypothesis that a certain Ext group is annihilated by the ideal power. The proof (source lines 5469-5545) represents the complex by a two-term complex with a projectivity property for the ideal power, reduces the vanishing to a factorisation statement using the description of maps out of an almost free module, and then verifies that factorisation by constructing a map to the structure sheaf of the closed subscheme and chasing the diagram (proof lines 5520-5545). The reduction to the factorisation and the diagram chase are the content. H2.
